decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, which limits the firm's ability to interpret results, but its maritime customer base and in-house R&D give it some related knowledge to assimilate learning.
The medical examination light builds on the firm's professional lighting expertise and has its own page, so in-house R&D and testing let the firm learn from early results and improve it.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's certified manufacturing and industrial customer knowledge, giving high absorptive capacity and a strong fit with its LED efficiency direction.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular existing product close to the core offer, so the firm can readily interpret its market feedback and refine it.
